anti_leakage_and_forbidden_actions: Do not query KTC or any dynasty market source for fit targets.
Do not use the deployed pick table as an outcome label.
Do not use 2026 realized NFL outcomes.
Do not tune around any named rookie or current trade.
Do not alter PICK_BASE, YEAR_DISCOUNT, pickValue(), or production UI.
Do not change future-year discount from this study.
Do not infer a multi-pick consolidation penalty from this study.
Do not deploy a candidate merely because historical validation passes.

C1_GLOBAL_RESCALE.interpretation: Tests whether shape is broadly right but absolute FV scale is wrong.

C2_LOW_PARAMETER_OUTCOME_CURVE.interpretation: Allows a distinct Round-1-to-2 cliff, smoother later-round decay, and shared monotone early/mid/late tier penalties.

C3_MONOTONE_CELL_DIAGNOSTIC.definition: Cell means projected onto the monotone partial order: earlier round >= later round and early >= mid >= late.
C3_MONOTONE_CELL_DIAGNOSTIC.role: Diagnostic upper bound only; never deployable from this study because its flexibility is too high for the expected class count.

frozen_replacement_ranks.lineage: Primary Phase-2 replacement ranks already used in roster-economics research.

age_bridge_configuration.age_as_of_rule: September 1 of each evaluated NFL season
age_bridge_configuration.note: This is a frozen role-neutral player-equivalent bridge, not a claim that historical rookies had the deployed Starter role. Fixing role prevents outcome-dependent role classification and keeps the absolute bridge reproducible.
age_bridge_configuration.production_arguments_rule: pass realized_prod_mult as both real_production and raw_production to snapshot_values.age_multiplier

frozen_scale_bridge.age_multiplier_source: scripts/validation/snapshot_values.py age_multiplier() using the deployed AGE_CURVE/QB/LB constants parsed from index.html

replacement_ppg_rule.short_position_fallback: use last eligible player only if fewer players than frozen rank

maturity_and_feasibility_gates.if_gate_fails: Stop with INSUFFICIENT_HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE. Do not fit a replacement curve and do not change production.

model_development_plan.O1_use: O1 normalized cell shape is a required robustness endpoint, not a coefficient-fitting target.
model_development_plan.development_classes: All primary-mature draft classes except the latest two.
model_development_plan.fit_loss: Equal-cell macro MAE across 18 round-tier cells. Each cell receives equal weight regardless of player count.
model_development_plan.locked_historical_validation_classes: The latest two primary-mature draft classes. They are not read for parameter fitting.
model_development_plan.optimizer: Deterministic bounded grid plus local refinement; no stochastic optimizer and no named-player exclusions based on results.

post_selection_rule.if_candidate_selected: Freeze the selected class and coefficients in a new immutable candidate artifact. Then design a separate confirmation step before any production bake.
post_selection_rule.if_no_candidate: Close Draft Pick FV V1 with production unchanged; no anecdotal rescue.

O1_shape.definition: For each drafted rookie and each of the first three NFL seasons beginning with the draft year, compute league-scored season total points. Within that same NFL season and position, rank the full NFL universe by season PPG among players with at least 3 games played; replacement PPG is the PPG at the frozen replacement rank (or the last eligible player only if the position has fewer eligible players than the frozen rank). Scheduled games = 16 for NFL seasons through 2020 and 17 for 2021 onward. Annual surplus = max(0, season_total - replacement_ppg * scheduled_games). Primary O1 is the sum of annual surplus across years 1-3.
O1_shape.name: three_year_replacement_adjusted_football_utility
O1_shape.scale_use: O1 is used to test relative round/tier SHAPE only. It is not called Fundamental Value and is not directly compared in raw units with deployed FV.

O2_scale.age_bridge: Use snapshot_values.age_multiplier(pos, age_on_september_1, role='Starter', real_production=realized_prod_mult, raw_production=realized_prod_mult, cfg=frozen_cfg). DOB must be resolved; no age guessing is permitted.
O2_scale.definition: For each of years 1-3, convert realized season production into a research player-equivalent FV using the current 5500 base, current position weight, deployed ageMultiplier at that season's age, and a frozen transparent realized production multiplier. O2 is the equal-weight arithmetic mean of those three annual player-equivalent FVs.
O2_scale.name: three_year_player_equivalent_fv

realized_production_multiplier.source_lineage: Frozen transparent Production V2 benchmark transform; not estimated from rookie-pick outcomes.

O2_scale.reason_for_mean_not_sum: A mean preserves the player's point-in-time FV unit scale. Summing annual FVs would create career-value units that are not comparable with current deployed player FV.

question: Does a market-independent outcome model of this league's actual historical rookie draft picks support the deployed draft-pick Fundamental Value scale and round/tier shape?

robustness.exact_slot_diagnostic: Report 1.01-1.12 within-round outcome means where sample permits, but do not fit 12 separate slot values in V1.

horizons.H3: primary; first three completed NFL seasons
horizons.H4: first four completed NFL seasons where mature

robustness.position_subgroups: Report offense (QB/RB/WR/TE) and IDP (DL/LB/DB) separately. Do not fit position-specific pick curves in V1.

replacement_rank_sensitivity.rule: No selected candidate may improve only because of one replacement-rank convention.

scope.note: V1 studies the value of the rookie-selection opportunity itself. Future-year time preference and package consolidation are separate economic questions and cannot be inferred cleanly from rookie outcomes.

birth_date_source.rule: No guessed DOB. Missing/unresolved DOB excludes that player from the absolute FV bridge but not from the raw football-utility shape endpoint.
birth_date_source.secondary: Sleeper player metadata only when independently consistent

historical_scoring_source.scoring_rule: Score every historical season under the calculator's current league scoring implementation, not under historical market value.

position_source.primary: draft-time Sleeper pick metadata collapsed to QB/RB/WR/TE/DL/LB/DB
position_source.secondary: nflverse/Sleeper player record only for missing draft metadata

draft_selection: draft must be a linear/non-snake dynasty rookie draft
draft must contain at least 4 rounds and no more than 8
initial startup draft is never treated as a rookie draft
if a season has more than one plausible rookie draft, that season is ambiguous and excluded rather than guessed
rookie_draft_order_source.method: Start from config.json league_id; walk previous_league_id season chain. For each predecessor season, inspect completed drafts and their draft picks.
rookie_draft_order_source.pick_cell_mapping: Within each round: slots 1-4 early, 5-8 mid, 9-12 late.

uncertainty.primary: Cluster bootstrap by rookie draft class; all picks from one class remain together in every bootstrap resample.
report: 95% interval for each round-tier O1 mean
95% interval for each round-tier O2 mean

eligibility_gates: validation macro MAE improvement versus C0 >= 5%
candidate improves MAE in each of the two locked validation draft classes
O1 normalized-shape macro error does not regress versus C0 by more than 2%
two-year O2 robustness MAE does not regress versus C0 by more than 2%
four-year O2 robustness, where mature, does not regress versus C0 by more than 2%
round monotonicity holds for every tier
early >= mid >= late holds for every round
non-null fitted parameter at a bound makes C1/C2 ineligible
validation_and_selection.winner_rule: Among eligible C1/C2 candidates, choose lowest validation O2 macro MAE. If within 1% relative MAE, choose fewer parameters. C3 can never win.
